headline: Ampol Shares Break Out to 52-Week High: What Is Driving the Price? - The Bull
summary: Ampol shares rose to a 52-week peak after Australia's competition watchdog approved its acquisition of EG Australia. The approval removes the final major obstacle to the deal, which will reshape the nation's fuel retail market.
why: Ampol is one of Australia's largest fuel retailers and refiners, and competition approval determines whether a major acquisition can proceed.
